name: testEqualsSelf
expected: Returns true because obj == this branch executes immediately.

name: testEqualsNull
expected: Returns false because obj == null check fails.

name: testEqualsDifferentClass
input: emf vs an instance of MessageFormat or a subclass like OtherExtendedMessageFormat
expected: Returns false because getClass() != obj.getClass() via ObjectUtils.notEqual.

name: testEqualsIdentical
input: Two different ExtendedMessageFormat instances with the same pattern and same registry
expected: Returns true because super.equals, class check, toPattern, and registry all match.

name: testEqualsDifferentPattern
input: Two ExtendedMessageFormat instances with different patterns but same registry
expected: Returns false because toPattern fields are not equal.

name: testEqualsDifferentRegistry
input: Two ExtendedMessageFormat instances with same pattern but different registries (e.g., one null, one populated)
expected: Returns false because registry fields are not equal.

name: testEqualsSuperEqualsDiff
input: Two ExtendedMessageFormat instances where super.equals returns false (e.g., different locales or base message configurations)
expected: Returns false because !super.equals(obj) check fails early.

name: hashCodeConsistency
input: Calling hashCode() multiple times on the same ExtendedMessageFormat instance
expected: Returns the exact same integer hash code value consistently.

name: hashCodeEqualityCondition
input: Two equal ExtendedMessageFormat instances (tested via equals() == true)
expected: Both instances return identical hash code values satisfying the equals/hashCode contract.

name: hashCodeWithNullRegistryAndPattern
input: ExtendedMessageFormat with null pattern / default state and null registry
expected: Computes hash code successfully using ObjectUtils.hashCode for null fields combined with HASH_SEED.

name: testEqualsNullPatterns
input: Two ExtendedMessageFormat instances where toPattern is null for both
expected: Returns true because both patterns are null (ObjectUtils.notEqual handles null correctly).

name: testEqualsNullRegistries
input: Two ExtendedMessageFormat instances where registry is null for both
expected: Returns true because both registries are null.
